entry_state: POCI recognises subsequent loss changes from its purchase baseline. A favourable change permits a negative signed allowance; its unwind is interest, not another credit gain. Financial derecognition leaves legal discharge unassessed.
exit_state: The separate instalment purchase includes its integral cost in yield. ACT/365F is a declared convention; unchanged intervals accrete gross and signed allowance together, while revised receipts change impairment. An identified unrecoverable portion now requires a distinct write-off.
findings: The POCI conclusion preserves missing forecasts, intermediate-payment methods and separate write-off findings.
Price 98 plus integral cost 2 gives carrying value 100, exactly matched by discounted expected instalments 55 and 60.5. The initial contractual shortfall remains embedded.
Day count is supplied as a convention rather than attributed to IFRS. The proportional no-recovery portion is a separate finding and assumption. No new defect observed.
